notes.title: New Timed Levels
notes.content:
Hey there,

New levels are here.

These levels have a different mechanic. There is a trigger that your agent need to push.
When pushed timer will start, and your agent need to reach to destination with it time.

Make the shortest path.

Murat,
CodingApe Games

notes.title: ACTION MODE
notes.content:
We added our first mode to the game.

Action mode;
In this mode, you can complete levels while shooting flying obstacles that target your agent.
Nail planks, stop balls, laser, make a path.

But now you have one more thing to do. Shoot with your "Nail Gun".

More is yet to come.
Next update will include new 10 levels.

See you soon.

Coding Ape Games

notes.title: Update 2 (Artifacts are here)
notes.content:
Hello there,

We thought we need to make the game a little harder. So;

Lasers now can break your nail. They can hold the laser for 3 second.
Spikes also can break like the balls.

AAAND

We added some artifacts. You can collect them in levels with your agent.
You can activate them from Artifact section on the wall.
Each of them will give you some treats. 

Have fun.

notes.title: First Update
notes.content:
